execution_route: Shared core.flight.cli campaign over the committed campaign plan configs/campaign/slurp-native-stage3-det-np1-fold-a-50-b-v1.json, step 2 of the two-step DET chain (scripts/flights/det/batch_chain_det.sh) on the DET serving session; the campaign acquires its own GenerationLease against the resident session and schedules one official score over the complete manifest at finalize.
one_factor: The serving geometry, and nothing else: one 24,576-token slot (np1 c24576) with the prompt cache OFF (--no-cache-prompt) and no --slot-prompt-similarity, against the resident np4 c98304 prompt-cache-on geometry. In the composed config it is the model fragment's server_args / profile_slot_count / geometry_basis plus the baseline's serving_slots 4 -> 1; every other non-bookkeeping key is the locked PLAN cell's own bytes.

prepared_phase_supply.note: NONE COMMITTED, by design: the flip mints each pass's own under its own run id (item E16); pass B's output block must reproduce pass A's byte for byte, and --allow-output-change must never be passed. The requirements lists are empty because core.flight.repin._set_preparation_requirement rewrites every preparation entry.

purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DET-NP1-FOLD-A-50-B-V1: cell DET pass B. DESCRIPTIVE; there is no verdict and no admission. The deliverable is a COUNT: the number of the 50 rows whose delivered answer (the sealed outputs row's text, whose response_text_sha256 the read re-derives) is byte-identical between pass A and pass B, reported beside the same statistic ROLL-AA produced at np4 within one flight (183 of 200, 91.5 %) and the cross-flight np4 disagreement the instrument note records (about 28 % of raw outputs); the pair's pooled SLU-F1 and intent paired deltas with a CI95 by row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) as descriptive numbers; the intent-flip and entity-set-flip shares where the sealed per-sample scores carry the parsed prediction; and (decision 140) contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second per pass beside ROLL-2's np4 numbers, in one table. ROUTING: 50 of 50 identical -> the coordinator scales to 200 rows for the floor re-estimate (a separate registration); fewer -> the offset is intrinsic and the axis closes. A 50-row cell cannot support a floor re-estimate.
quality_read_gate: No read before BOTH passes' complete sealed manifests, exact ordered outputs, native phase summaries and single successful complete official TRAIN scores exist, and before the stop stage of scripts/analysis/slurp_det_pair_read.py has verified both attempts FINALIZED, both manifests COMPLETED on the 50-row split identity, and every delivered text re-hashing to its recorded digest. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
